description: Drafts a polite payment-reminder email (text only — nothing is sent) for each customer with overdue invoices, listing the invoices and amounts. Edit it, then the business sends it — or use accounting_send_invoice_reminder to send GetAccountED's standard branded reminder for one invoice. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

min_days_overdue.description: Only invoices at least this many days overdue (default 1)

name: accounting_debtor_reminder
title: Draft payment-reminder emails
